'''Kyphosis''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Deterrent Parasites|Deterrent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned on Infested Blocks by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Kyphosis are Far reaching Melee defensive units, incapable of movement. 

*Their Melee Attack, performed by repeatedly stabbing the target with their whip like point, inflicts massive knockback and AoE Damage.
* If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Kyphosis can perform the following abilities:
**Generate Waves, small damaging areas of disturbed ground. After standing still for a brief period, they will summon a Wave which homes toward the target at fast speed but is unable to move up blocks. Waves deal very high damage per second and ignore immunity frames.
*** This is telegraphed by flame particles and a loud click.

*Kyphosis can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 7, with a 20-tick cooldown and 3-block range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Kyphosis, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Kyphosis are also known as '''Tonro''' in the Mod Files.
*Kyphosis are named after a condition that involves abnormal front-to-back curving of the spine, which results in a slouch.
*Kyphosis are inspired by the [https://stephenkingsthemist.fandom.com/wiki/Tentacles_from_Planet_X Tentacles] from The Mist.
